changelog: Calls whose RTP does not carry a Call-ID can now reconstruct audio from database storage when their captured RTP matches a persisted SDP destination IP and port
New RTP blobs contain one destination flow and are explicitly marked as safely correlated. Older rows remain untrusted, preventing audio from concurrent calls f
changelog_es: DB-backed audio reconstruction now persists bounded SDP offer/answer endpoints and correlates RTP without Call-ID by exact time, destination IP and destination
RTP database blobs are segregated by destination flow and explicitly marked as safely keyed. Existing rows remain untrusted by default.
Investigate enables reconstruction only for a known SSRC or an exact flow-keyed RTP/SDP match, eliminating the false-positive button.
